sections.heading: Quoted literals
sections.before_text: Use no prefix / `r` for valid UTF-8 strings, `b/br` for `[byte; L]`, and `c/cr` for `[byte; L+1]` with an appended NUL. `r/br/cr` preserve backslashes; interpolation remains enabled only for no prefix / `r`.
sections.after_text: One quote is single-line inline form, two quotes encode an empty payload, and three or more quotes form a block. A block opener is followed immediately by a newline; its exact-count closer occupies its own line. Increase the quote count when a quote-only payload line would collide.

sections.heading: String interpolation
sections.after_text: Note: `${...}` is scanned as an expression, so nested strings may use the same quote as the outer template.

sections.heading: Common methods
sections.markdown:
- `len(s)` counts Unicode scalars; `len(s.bytes())` counts UTF-8 bytes
- `s.startsWith(prefix)` / `s.endsWith(suffix)`
- `s.indexOf(sub)` / `s.contains(sub)`
- `s.slice(start, end)` / `s.split(sep)` / `s.replace(old, new)`
